cells.tense: You are here with your hands on what you are tending, and the strength is moving outward by measure.
cells.ask: Pick the one thing you actually want to grow and say out loud today why it matters, then put one hour behind it that no one asked you for.
cells.core:
You have a steadiness that reaches past you, toward what needs you, and it lands. Grown things want more of it. The care you run on gives a thing room and then waits, and it is working now, which is the part that is easy to miss from inside a day.

The test used to be whether the help was wanted. Now it is whether the growth is real, because the questions changed. The ask points that same strength at what you are growing: name what you care about and show up for it an hour the way the rest of the day gets shown up for. The cost is that some of that hour has to be yours, not handed to whoever calls.
cells.sheetLine: You already steady what needs growing. Give it an hour no one asked for.

cells.tense: Somewhere ahead you can already see the shape this should take, and you are leaning into a future that has not arrived.
cells.ask: Before acting on the next worry, write one line about what has actually happened. If the worries outnumber the facts, wait a day.
cells.core:
The support is running ahead of what is there. You can see the thing finished or failing, and you are already pouring your strength into the version in your head, so the help arrives before there is anything to help. What you offer is genuine and its timing is early. Support stops being steady when it is aimed at a scene that has not grown yet.

The test is whether what you are giving is wanted now or wanted in theory. The ask is to put a line between the worries that are happening and the ones you drew in advance, and wait a day before acting on the drawn ones. What that costs is the push, no more forcing a growth that is not here by forcing a plan ahead of it.
cells.sheetLine: You are steadying a future thing. Let present facts grow first.

cells.tense: Back there the sharing you offered did not land, and you have been standing at that closed door since.
cells.ask: Name one thing you still want to grow, tell one person it is still alive, and do one small move toward it this week.
cells.core:
The strength is still in you. What stopped is the offering, the part where the strength leaves your hands and goes toward something growing. A version of this did not work out before, and no fault was yours in it. The effect is simply that the same flare does not leave your hands anymore. Care for what is growing is getting fed less than it was giving.

The test is whether the next move is allowed to be small and unproven, enough to re-open the door by being done rather than by being certain. The ask looks like saying out loud one thing you still want to grow and making one move toward it within the week, with no verdict expected. Letting that move count keeps the opening there.
cells.sheetLine: The strength did not leave. The offering did. Start one small move.

cells.tense: You are already the one carrying what is growing for the people around you, and you call it how the day goes.
cells.ask: Name which growing thing you mostly hold for others, pick one part of it that is yours, and say that part out loud to one person.
cells.core:
We only have to look at a week to see the support moving. You check on people, you cover, you remember, you steady. When someone needs a hand, the hand is already there, and nothing has to be explained first. That is a real gift, and it is why people bring their growing things to you instead of to someone faster or louder.

None of it is done blindly, and you have been filing it under errands. Your hand was on the pen the whole time. The test is whether that can travel. Pick one part of the growth you hold for others that is genuinely yours, one decision that was yours, and say so plainly to one person. That puts your name on something you were already doing. Once it is said, you cannot call it an accident.
cells.sheetLine: You are already holding what is growing. Say which part is yours.
